summary: English and Urdu first-party discovery identified PLRA as the provincial land-record custodian and confirmed an Arazi Record Centre for Tehsil Mian Channu. The current PLRA JavaScript exposes a Khanewal raster map tile configuration; an exact-point tile returned HTTP 200 PNG, while the public ArcGIS REST directory exposed no parcel vector service. No parcel ID-plus-geometry response or GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, response outcomes, viewer configuration, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-7659-mian-channu.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private token, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.
